chapter: Cavalcade, Wynonie Harris and the 1953 show
title: The House of Blues and Booze sign
summary: Harris repainted a club sign to read the House of Blues and Booze, which the liquor authority disliked.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: But is it true that when he was living
on Long Island somewhere he had a big electric sign on his house, said King of the Blues or something?
No, they used his name in a club called (inaudible). The put a sign up there --

No, this was a club they had, they a concession. And they had a sign up. So he went out there one day, wasn't nobody there, and took some paint and changed it. Let me see, Wally Harris, The House of Blues and Booze. And the liquor authority didn't like it. They wanted to take that sign down. The House of Blues and Booze.
